Class GermanTaxClassifier

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.tax.germany.GermanTaxClassifier
public final class GermanTaxClassifier extends Object
Decides how the German tax help treats an instrument. It reads the special instrument first, so that a bond ETF stays a fund and is no other capital claim. An instrument that no rule covers is unclassified: the report lists its bookings but puts them in no sum.
